description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value that is unique for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.
